items.question: How does AI detect attendance fraud?
items.answer: Appsisten AI automatically detects fake GPS, unusual attendance patterns, and location anomalies. The system compares location data with history and provides real-time alerts if fraud is detected.

items.question: Does payroll calculation include tax and BPJS?
items.answer: Yes, our system automatically calculates PPh 21, BPJS Health, BPJS Employment, THR, and all salary components according to the latest Indonesian regulations. Digital payslips are sent directly to employees.

items.question: Can employees request leave and overtime via mobile?
items.answer: Absolutely. Employees can clock in/out, request leave, claim overtime, and access payslips through the mobile app. Managers receive instant notifications for approval.

items.question: What AI features are available?
items.answer: Appsisten AI includes: attendance anomaly detection, automatic payroll calculation, 24/7 HR chatbot for employees, turnover prediction, and team performance insights. Everything works automatically without manual input.

items.question: What's the pricing and is there a free trial?
items.answer: Starting from FREE for up to 5 employees. Paid plans start at Rp299k/month. All paid plans include a 14-day free trial without credit card.

items.question: Is there a discount for annual payment?
items.answer: Yes, you get 20% off with annual billing. For Enterprise with 100+ employees, contact our sales team for custom pricing.
